sections.title: Requests
sections.description: Control what is sent, which headers travel and what the server sends back.

snippets.code:
<!-- hx-params keeps only the named fields in the body -->
<form hx-post="/preview" hx-target="#preview" hx-params="title, body">
  <input name="title" value="Q3 review">
  <textarea name="body">Revenue grew 12%.</textarea>
  <input name="draft" value="never sent">
  <button type="submit">Preview</button>
</form>

<!-- per-request headers and an 8s timeout -->
<button hx-get="/rates?base=EUR"
        hx-headers='{"X-Client": "dashboard"}'
        hx-request='{"timeout": 8000}'
        hx-target="#rates">Refresh rates</button>
<footer id="rates">1 EUR = 1.09 USD</footer>

sections.title: Forms
sections.description: Submit forms, add fields htmx would not send, and keep the URL in sync.

snippets.code: No order yet

<form id="filters" hx-get="/products" hx-target="#grid" hx-push-url="true">
  <input name="city" value="Lisbon">
  <label><input type="checkbox" name="instant" checked> Instant delivery</label>
  <button type="submit">Filter</button>
</form>

<select id="sort" name="sort">
  <option value="price">Price</option>
  <option value="rating">Rating</option>
</select>

<!-- pull values from outside the element and add one fixed field -->
<button hx-get="/products"
        hx-include="#filters, #sort"
        hx-vals='{"page": 1}'
        hx-target="#grid">Apply sort</button>
